question: Breakdown of pyruvate into lactic acid and energy in lack of oxygen takes place in which of the following?
solution:
the correct answer is __**Human muscle cells**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Human muscle cells**

 
 
• Aerobic respiration is a process in which the breakdown of glucose occurs in the presence of oxygen. Anaerobic respiration is a process in which food can also be broken down in the absence of oxygen. 
 
• The breakdown of glucose takes place in three ways that are as follows
 
• The food is broken down to release energy in the presence of oxygen to give carbon dioxide, water, and energy.
 
• The organisms that can survive in the absence of air are called anaerobes. Through the anaerobic respiration process, they get the energy to survive. In the absence of oxygen, glucose breaks down into alcohol and carbon dioxide.
 
• When there is a temporary deficiency of oxygen, Our muscle cells respire anaerobically for a short period of time. During heavy exercise, fast running, cycling, walking for many hours, or heavy weight lifting, the demand for energy is high. But the supply of oxygen to produce the energy is limited. The demand for energy in the muscle cells takes place through anaerobic​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bacteria**

 
 
• Bacteria are microscopic prokaryotes (single-celled organisms). They are the sole members of Kingdom Monera.
 
• Bacteria have variations in their shape, on the basis of their shape bacteria are of different types like : 
 
 
• Coccus 
 
• Bacillus
 
• Spirillum
 
• Vibrio
 
 
 
 

 
• Yeast

 
 
• “Yeast is a fungus that grows as a single cell, alternately as a mushroom,” assumes Laura Rusche, associate professor of biological sciences. 
 
• Though every yeast organism is made up of just one cell, yeast cells live jointly in multicellular colonies.
 
• Yeast cells are classified as fungi as they have some characteristics similar to fungi, such as the presence of chitin in cell walls, extracellular digestion, saprophytic mode of nutrition, asexual reproduction by budding, and food reserved as glycogen.
 
 
 
• ​Mitochondria
 
 
• Mitochondria is a double-layered cell organelle, in which the outer layer is porous and the inner layer is folded upon itself is known to be cristae.
 
• The number of mitochondria in a single cell may be up to 50 to 5000.
 
• The inner lumen of mitochondria contains ribosome phosphate particles and DNA molecules.
 
• It has the potential to synthesize its own protein and the oxidation of carbohydrates and fats are taken place with the help of enzymes in mitochondria.
 
• This energy is stored in the form of ATP ( Adenosine Triphosphate ) so, these are known as the "Powerhouse of the cell".
